shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; rg -n -i -C 4 "table" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p; echo -----; ls -R src; cat src/*; cat tsconfig.json index.html vite.config.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Checkbox 2>&1 | head -60; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Pagination 2>&1 | head -40; grep -n "Table\|Pagination" build/esm/components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/Table.d.ts Table/index.d.ts; ls Table/hoc Table/hoc/*; cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts Pagination/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && cat withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -120; grep -n "getRowId\|getRowDescriptor\|selectedIds" withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
